text:
auditor_sam: Hi all — during fieldwork the auditor asked for evidence that the RBAC change to restrict 'inference-service' admin rights to SRE+Infra during the 2025-03-10 commit window was applied and reviewed. Also need KMS decrypt audit trail for the customer key and the vuln triage notes for CVE-2025-1234. Can you point me to the exports or attach artifacts? Thanks.
maria: Hey Sam — we have the PR, the k8s RoleBinding diff, and the rollout job run. For KMS, do you want full usage history or just the window around 2025-03-10? We also have a vuln board doc with triage notes.
devin: I can bundle: PR link, RoleBinding YAML snapshot, and CloudTrail KMS events filtered for the CMK. For sampling here's the CloudTrail CLI I used:```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/audit-exports/7402345678/ ./ --recursive
```
Sharing a presigned export in a sec.
alex_rtc: Also note we rotated the key on 2025-02-28, so the auditor probably wants both pre- and post-rotation usage. I can generate a key-rotation proof: KMS key metadata + CloudTrail Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events for both key versions.
maria: Quick checkpoint — RBAC change PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123 (contains reviewer list and approval timestamps). RoleBinding diff attached in export bundle. Rollout job: `ci/rollouts/2025-03-10-inference-admin` shows canary -> full with timestamped logs.
SRE-bot: evidence-bundle /exports/7402345678 created (size: 42MB) :package:
devin: Uploaded bundle here (presigned): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/audit-exports/7402345678/evidence-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Algorithm=... (expires in 7 days) — contains: PR.pdf, rolebinding-snapshot.yaml, cloudtrail-kms-events.json, key-rotation-manifest.json, vuln-triage-notes.md, incident-timeline.csv
auditor_sam: Thanks — for the vuln triage notes can you confirm who did the code-level review and whether a mitigation (WAF rule + dependency upgrade) was put in place before the change window? Need names and timestamps.
maria: Code review was by @devin and @alex_rtc (see PR approvals). Timestamps: review complete 2025-03-09T18:12Z, mitigation deployed 2025-03-10T02:03Z (WAF rule ID wf-9876 applied), dependency bump pushed to `go.mod` and deployed in the same rollout. All of that is in vuln-triage-notes.md.
devin: Confirmed. The triage doc has the exploitability assessment, PoC status (none public), and mitigation verification steps (unit+integration run IDs). Snippet:```text
Mitigation: bump github.com/fastparse v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3; WAF rule wf-9876 applied; verified with e2e-74023
Reviewer: devin (dev), alex_rtc (sre)
Deployment: 2025-03-10T02:03Z rollout job #1987
```
auditor_sam: Perfect. One last ask — can you include a short narrative that links the RBAC change, the key usage logs, and the mitigation so the control owner can sign off? A one-paragraph map is fine.
maria: Will draft and attach by EOD. Quick Q for oncall: any incident or rollback related to that rollout? If yes I need the incident runbook.
alex_rtc: No rollbacks recorded. Oncall pinged for elevated CPU during rollout but we tracked to a hot batch job and mitigated; no security impact. I added a short blurb to incident-timeline.csv.
auditor_sam: Great — once I get the bundle and the narrative we can close this item. Appreciated! :thumbsup:
